editorial.blurb: Joy Yee is a Chinatown favorite where vibrant house-made drinks and boldly flavored dishes arrive in generous portions, served by staff who genuinely make you feel welcome.
editorial.insiderTip: Go during off-peak hours to avoid crowds and long waits, or be prepared to queue during rush times—the bathrooms get strained when it's packed.
signatureDishes: Grilled short ribs over kimchi fried rice
Fried chicken and pork dumplings with sweet chilli sauce
